description: Generic encrypted incremental backup to a remote filesystem service (googleDrive, rcloneFilesystem, or any other filesystem-tool-compatible destination already configured on this PawFlow instance). Independent of any business package.

objects.name: incremental_backup
objects.description: Diffs a relay-local source root against the last known encrypted manifest at a destination filesystem service, uploads only new/changed files (encrypted, opaque blob names), and writes a new manifest. Encryption is always on; never optional.

source_path.description: Relay-local root directory to back up

destination_service.description: Filesystem service id at the destination (e.g. a configured googleDrive or rcloneFilesystem service name)

destination_root.description: Root path at the destination under which manifests/blobs are written

exclude.description: Path segment names to skip anywhere in the tree (e.g. ['.git', 'node_modules', '__pycache__', '.venv'])

keep_manifests.description: How many timestamped manifests to retain (retention/purge)

objects.name: restore_from_backup
objects.description: Reads a chosen (or latest) encrypted manifest from the destination and downloads+decrypts every referenced file into a relay-local target root. Requires the same passphrase used for the backup.

destination_service.description: Filesystem service id the backup was written to

destination_root.description: Root path at the destination the backup was written under

manifest_timestamp.description: Timestamped manifest to restore from (omit for the latest known state)

target_path.description: Relay-local root directory to restore into
